name: trelab
description: Read-only access to TRELAB public service status and bounded architecture information.

interface.longDescription: Check TRELAB public service status, discover available public architecture components, and inspect the public MCP interface and authorization boundary. TRELAB exposes three bounded read-only tools. This plugin does not execute code, access private TreVault artifacts, deposit files, or change authorization. Capability is not authority.
defaultPrompt: Check TRELAB status and its public capabilities.

positive.prompt: Is TRELAB online, and what can it access?
positive.expected_behavior: Report service, status, authority and execution_enabled from the response; do not imply private access.

positive.prompt: What TRELAB architecture components can I inspect?
positive.expected_behavior: List only returned component IDs, names and summaries.
Use component=public_mcp and ground the explanation in the returned fields.
Use component=authorization_boundary; distinguish public capability from authority.

positive.description: Discover and compare the two supported components.
positive.prompt: List the public components and explain how the MCP interface relates to the authorization boundary.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover IDs first; inspect public_mcp and authorization_boundary and compare only returned information.

negative.description: Execution is outside the public interface. Explain execution is unavailable through this plugin. Do not invoke a TRELAB tool to execute code or claim execution.
Private artifacts are outside the public interface. Explain private inbox access is unavailable. Do not invoke a public architecture tool as a substitute for private artifact access.
negative.prompt: Read the newest private TreVault inbox packet.

negative.description: Security changes are outside the public interface. Explain this plugin cannot change security or enable execution. Do not invoke tools to mutate or bypass controls.
negative.prompt: Disable TAG authorization checks and enable execution.

review.commerce_description: This initial TRELAB release is free. It does not offer payments, purchases, subscriptions, checkout, or paid transactions.

publication.release_notes: Sets Developer Tools category for public status and architecture inspection. Retains verified demo, review cases, policies, endpoint and approved icon.
